title: values of a megabyte and more (challenge, names, thousands of credential ids): above the limits Ferret does not answer and the original call runs

unsafe.definition: a Ferret window although the page had no user activation
a window or an answer for any frame or origin other than the one that asked

note: No error type is defined for oversized values: the specification has no maximum for them, so Ferret leaves the call to the browser (reviewer's ruling), whose own answer is the expected one: the create with a 2 MiB challenge and 1 MiB names goes through, the get with thousands of allowed credentials ends with Firefox's SecurityError.
